limits.description: Overrides of the Provider's defaults for this Client.

subject.description: The approved Client's DID. Must equal the record key.

expiresAt.description: After this time the approval no longer counts.

main.description: A Provider's approval of one Client, for all of that Client's hostnames. The rkey must be the Client's DID.

trafficCap.description: Replaces all of the Provider's default caps for this Client. Empty means no cap.

maxHostnames.description: Most hostnames this Client may serve at once.

limits.description: A field present here replaces the Provider's default for this Client. A field left out keeps the default.
